ev.q: This report describes 10 patients from four states, with whole genome sequencing (WGS)–confirmed Omicron variant infections within 90 days of a previous Delta infection.
Among eight patients with available clinical data during reinfection, six were symptomatic during reinfection

Eight patients were aged <18 years, one was a long-term care facility resident, and one was a health care worker
Nine patients were symptomatic during first infection (median duration = 9 days; range = 0–20 days).
Intervals between initial and subsequent specimen collections ranged from 23 to 87 days (median = 54.5 days).
